deviations.what: sap.m.SinglePlanningCalendar calendarWeekNumbering is @since 1.110.0 - newer than the 1.71 floor. The four week-numbering schemes ARE the sample, so the property is kept and the port is filed under src/02.

The calendar date properties (the SinglePlanningCalendar startDate and every CalendarAppointment startDate and endDate) are typed "object" and demand a real JS Date. The model keeps ISO strings and Formatter.DateCreateObject from the curated module converts them at the point of use, the same idiom app 108 uses (needs UI5 >= 1.74).

The original keeps the sticky mode in a SECOND named model (settings>) and a third (allDay>) the view never reads. abap2UI5 keeps one default model, so the sticky mode is a field here and the Select and the calendar share it - the same two-way link the named model gives them; the unused allDay model is dropped.
onChange calls setCalendarWeekNumbering. The property is bindable, so the Select shares its key with the calendar and the change handler is dropped.
Some appointment rows carry a tentative flag the view never binds; the port seeds it the same way and leaves it unbound, so the data stays 1:1 with the mock.
The four week-numbering schemes, the three sticky modes and the four calendar views are unverified in a running system.
